author: Pennant, 1769
status: 나그네새, 해마다 수십 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
habitat: 논, 호소, 초습지, 도랑의 갈대밭과 물가 풀숲
summary: 봄과 가을에 서해안을 따라 드물게 지나가는 나그네새로, 논, 호소, 초습지, 도랑 등의 갈대밭과 물가 풀숲에 산다. 갈대나 대나무, 관목 위에 갈잎으로 접시 모양 둥지를 틀며, 물가 풀숲의 땅 위에 짓기도 한다. 한배에 알을 4~8개 낳는다. 곤충과 조개류를 즐겨 먹고 풀씨와 낟알도 먹으며, 파키스탄 서부에서 인도 북부, 미얀마, 중국, 일본에 이르는 지역에 분포한다.

points.en: white face, throat, breast and belly

art.subject: White-breasted Waterhen (Amaurornis phoenicurus), adult as seen on Korean west-coast wetlands on spring and autumn passage (sexes alike): forehead, face, chin, throat, foreneck, breast and centre of the belly pure white, cleanly and sharply divided from the dark parts; crown, hindneck, back, wings and tail dark slate-grey with an olive tinge; flanks dark slate; lower belly, vent and undertail coverts rufous-chestnut. Bill yellowish-green with a red patch at the base of the upper mandible; long legs and toes yellow.
art.pose: walking along the edge of a reed bed beside a ditch
art.scene: Korean west-coast rice paddies and reedy ditches during spring or autumn migration; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view walking along a ditch edge: pure white forehead, face, throat, breast and belly, dark slate-grey crown, hindneck, back and flanks with a sharp border, chestnut undertail, yellowish-green bill with a red base, long pale yellow legs
adult, rear three-quarter view with tail raised: rufous-chestnut lower belly, vent and undertail coverts below the dark slate tail and back
art.build: Medium-sized rail, about 32.5cm long, about the size of a Common Moorhen but slimmer and longer-legged. Upright stance, small head, short neck. Bill stout, a little shorter than the head, straight and pointed, without a large frontal shield. Legs long and yellow with very long toes. Short tail, frequently jerked up to flash the chestnut undertail. Walks in the open at reed edges and runs quickly to cover.
avoid: Do not paint a red frontal shield and a white flank line — that is Common Moorhen (Gallinula chloropus).
Do not wash the white face and breast with grey or buff; it is clean white.
Do not paint a long, slender rail bill; the bill is short and stout.
Do not paint the female differently; the sexes look alike.
